nodes.label: Temporal Graph Network (TGN) Dynamic Embedding Engine
nodes.description: Continuous-time dynamic graph learning framework updating node memory states via sequence models and graph memory modules upon each edge interaction event.

nodes.label: Differential Privacy Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD)
nodes.description: Privacy-preserving optimization protocol bounding privacy loss via per-sample gradient clipping and Gaussian noise addition during neural graph representation learning.

nodes.label: AraBERT Pre-trained Arabic Language Model
nodes.description: BERT-based Arabic transformer model pre-trained on large-scale Modern Standard Arabic corpora utilizing Farasa morphological segmentation for semantic representation.

nodes.label: RocksDB LSM-Tree Edge Ingestion Storage Engine
nodes.description: High-throughput embedded persistent key-value store leveraging Log-Structured Merge-trees (LSM) for low-latency batch edge insertion and block cache optimization.

nodes.label: Katz Centrality & Subgraph Centrality Computation
nodes.description: Spectral graph theory algorithm measuring node influence by computing attenuated walks of varying lengths across adjacency matrix representations.
